bio: Sitri’s mercenary company is one of the most ruthless and capable in all of Amara, and they take after Sitri herself. Running such a professional outfit demands poise, power, and panache – and Sitri has plenty. Nothing shakes her, neither in the boardroom or on the battlefield.
